acceptanceCriteria: Merging is a pure function of the ranked rows and is order-stable.
A merged row lists every contributing slot and hit range so inclusion still explains itself.
Packet bytes at a fixed budget never rise and frozen-evaluation recall never falls.
body: Owner requested this on 2026-09-23 after reviewing Tencent/WeKnora (MIT) as prior art; this ticket records an idea, not delivery or promotion. Original Go work only; no source import. WeKnora is an LLM-at-ingest, database-backed RAG platform, so only the mechanism is borrowed and it must stay deterministic, local and read-only under AGENTS.md invariants 4 and 7. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Prior art: website-docs/02-architecture/04-rag-pipeline.md of https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora. The CHUNK_MERGE stage runs before FILTER_TOP_K and applies deduplication, parent-child resolution, sequential merging of adjacent chunks, neighbour expansion and overlap removal, so the final top-k spends its budget on distinct text. Current state: the packet is a top-k list of rows; two rows from one file whose line ranges touch or overlap are budgeted twice and shown twice. Idea: add a deterministic merge step after ranking and before the byte budget that joins touching or overlapping ranges within one file into one span, keeps the best reason and the contributing slots, and drops exact duplicates; report merged and dropped counts in coverage. This frees budget for V1-0023 summaries and V1-0098 spans. Owning spec: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md.
title: context: merge adjacent rows and remove overlaps before budget truncation
